panel.emptyDescription: Use Network Manager to add a VPN

settings.shared-effect: VPN connections are shared across the system. This widget keeps its own display and action notification choices; connecting, disconnecting or removing a VPN affects every widget.
settings.connectedColorDescription: Chose the color to use for icon and text when connected
settings.disconnectedColorDescription: Chose the color to use for icon and text when disconnected
settings.disableToastNotificationsDescription: Do not show toast notifications when a VPN connects or disconnects

common.actionBusy: That VPN action is already running. Try again when it finishes.
